date.source: The show's own title card and dateline, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy the same day in four parts plus a dark-matches post.

appearances.note: Interfered in the main event with the Psychotic Doctor after being suspended; both were arrested by police on-air.
Interfered in the main event with Gorilla after being suspended; both were arrested by police on-air.

matches.note: Durango won with a spinning DDT off the second rope after a slow start.
Joe Williams made the debuting Night submit to the Deep Freeze.
Hrankiwskyj won with the Hrankiwskyj Devastation, then beat down Sengir with brass knuckles after the bell.

Main event. The referee overturned an apparent SuperPowers win on a legal-man technicality; the Mongolian Assassins then finished with the Twilight Drop. The suspended Crazed Animals ran in afterward and were arrested by police on-air.
Dark match, McQuaid's debut, won with his finisher, the Thundercracker.
Dark match, won with the Stardust Press.
Dark match.

date.source: The show's own title card and dateline, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy in five parts plus a dark-match post, this pass's own reading of the pre-merger [NaWF]-tagged corpus.

appearances.note: Also appeared with Gorilla in a mocking parody segment against a blow-up doll standing in for the injured Sammy Parker.
Also orchestrated a backstage beatdown of Sammy Parker and Mike Hrankiwskyj and a mocking doll-match parody of Parker.
On-air debut in a dark match, ahead of his 14 September on-air appearance.
Beaten and injured backstage by the Crazed Animals ahead of his scheduled match, which never happened.
Beaten backstage by the Crazed Animals ahead of his scheduled match against Sammy Parker, which never happened; the Psychotic Doctor mockingly wrestled a doll in the match's place.
Managed Joe Williams to the cage match, attacking Kabuki Master with a chair after the bell.
One of two unidentified men who beat down the Crazed Animals, then turned on and attacked the SuperPowers; identified as one of the Mongolian Assassins in a later broadcast's recap.
One of two unidentified men who beat down the Crazed Animals, then turned on and attacked the SuperPowers; identified as one of the Mongolian Assassins in a later broadcast's recap.

matches.note: Burden called out the suspended Crazed Animals in the ring; Gorilla stayed at ringside while the Doc wrestled, and Burden won with his finisher, "Burden of Truth," while taunting Gorilla throughout.

matches.stipulation: Originally called off by President Hopper on medical grounds after the SuperPowers were attacked on Monday Night Battlezone, then reinstated at the Powers' own insistence.
matches.note: The SuperPowers won when Scott Powers caught a Full Monty monkey flip and turned it into a powerbomb for the pin. Afterward, the Crazed Animals attacked both Powers brothers with a chair and holds until two unidentified large men ran in, beat down the Animals, then turned on and suplexed the SuperPowers themselves.
Durango ambushed Gorilla from the crowd and handcuffed the Psychotic Doctor to the guardrail before the bell, then beat Gorilla with a scissored-arm facebuster he calls "Rotten to the Core."

matches.stipulation: Main event cage match; win by escaping the cage to the floor.
matches.note: Kabuki Master won by reaching the floor after diving off the top of the cage through a table outside, narrowly beating a rolling Joe Williams to the floor on the other side. Steve Jackson then hit Kabuki with a chair and a ladder after the bell.
Dark match, Sengir's debut; won with a belly-to-belly piledriver variation he calls "The Setting Sun."

date.source: The show's own title card and dateline, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy in five parts plus a dark-matches post the day after air.

appearances.note: Interview segment with his valet before the dark-match card; a scheduled on-air bout with Burden was moved to the dark card for time.
Clashed with backstage reporter Dyan Cicarelli outside Sengir's locker room.
His own flame-throwing gadget, meant for Bobby Durango, exploded in his own face after Kabuki Master sprayed him with green mist.
Named as one of the promotion's Executive Vice Presidents at the pay-per-view contract-signing press conference.
Named as one of the promotion's Executive Vice Presidents at the pay-per-view contract-signing press conference.
Named as one of the promotion's Executive Vice Presidents at the pay-per-view contract-signing press conference.

matches.note: Kabuki Master won by disqualification after the Crazed Animals ran in and attacked him, ostensibly to help Hrankiwskyj; Hrankiwskyj refused their offer of an alliance afterward.

Durango won with "Rotten to the Core" after Kabuki Master warded off a ringside interference attempt by Steve Jackson, whose flame-throwing device exploded in his own face after Kabuki sprayed him with green mist.

matches.stipulation: Main event four-way tag dance for the four teams the Crazed Animals had attacked or interfered with over the prior fortnight; first fall wins.
matches.note: The Crazed Animals sent two lookalike midgets into the ring as a decoy before ambushing all six other men from the crowd. The Mongolian Assassins eliminated the Chippendales; the Crazed Animals eliminated the SuperPowers; Gorilla submitted Kublai with the Gorilla's Press to win the match for his team.
Dark match, Night's debut; won with a running powerslam after a move he calls "the Meltdown."

Dark match, Night Patrol's debut, against an unnamed local team ("the Militia"); won by pinfall with their finisher, "the Police Brutality," refusing to pin their opponents until they were thoroughly beaten down.
Dark match against an unnamed local wrestler ("the Twin Killa"); Extreme won by pinfall with his finisher, a springboard moonsault legdrop he calls "The Extreme."
Dark match, moved from the on-air card for time; Sengir won with "The Setting Sun" after wearing down Burden's legs; Burden beat Sengir down after the bell.

date.source: The show's own title card and dateline, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy in four parts.

appearances.note: Managed Spellbinder, then was hog-tied with an apple in his mouth by Rune and a masked attacker after the match.
Accompanied Shane Larson to his debut win.
Managed Night Patrol, handing Sgt. Garcia a chair during their bout with the Chippendales.
Appeared with the Psychotic Doctor on a taped segment declaring the Crazed Animals legally cleared to return.
Appeared with Gorilla on a taped segment declaring the Crazed Animals legally cleared to return.

matches.note: Both men's debut in the promotion; McQuaid won with a sunset flip after a back-and-forth finish.
Night Patrol's on-air debut; Lt. Blazer pinned the Full Monty with a powerbomb after Brenda Hawkins handed Sgt. Garcia a chair to help break up a Chippendales comeback.

matches.stipulation: Both men's debut in the promotion.
matches.note: Rune won with a top-rope tombstone piledriver he calls "the Runestone" after a chair-shot exchange; a masked attacker in black then interfered, and Rune joined in beating Spellbinder down and hog-tying his manager, David Bahner, with an apple in his mouth.

matches.stipulation: Main event; both men's debut in the promotion.
matches.note: Larson won with a kick he calls "the Yammer Jammer" moments after kicking out of Shakanuzi's own finisher, forcing Shakanuzi's retirement from the promotion on the loss.

date.source: The show's own title card and dateline, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy in five parts.

appearances.note: Present for Shane Larson's ambush by Bobby Durango backstage; unharmed.
Led Night Patrol to the ring for the opening match.
Introduced himself publicly, broke with President Hopper over the Crazed Animals' suspension, and guaranteed the pair a spot in the main event.

matches.note: Night Patrol won with their finisher, "the Police Brutality," after Sgt. Garcia recovered from a low blow; the show's own card graphic misprints the SuperPowers' opponent as the Chippendales.

matches.stipulation: 20-man battle royal for the vacant NaWF/AeWF Dangerzone Championship, over-the-top-rope elimination.

eliminations.note: Bodyslammed over the top alongside Black Widow.
Bodyslammed over the top alongside Enrique Valasquez.
Eliminated in a triple over-the-top spot alongside both members of the Mongolian Assassins, engineered by Shane Larson.
Eliminated in a triple over-the-top spot alongside Genghis and Brown Recluse.
Eliminated in a triple over-the-top spot alongside Kublai and Brown Recluse.
Sent to the floor with a back body drop.
Thrown over the top after arguing with Rune.
Shoved off the top rope through a ringside table during a corner exchange with the Doc.
Shoved off the top turnbuckle during a superplex attempt on Kabuki Master, eliminated first of the pair.
Shoved off the top turnbuckle alongside the Psychotic Doctor, eliminated second.
Pulled over the top from the apron.
Pulled to the floor in retaliation moments after eliminating Spellbinder.
Self-eliminated with a suicide dive onto the fallen Shane Larson outside the ring.
Knocked out along with Rune when Gorilla's punch, meant to stop a chair shot, sent both men over the top.
Knocked out alongside Joe Williams by the same punch.
Pulled into the path of a chair swing Durango meant for Gorilla, then led over the top.
Carried over the top in a headlock after a rope-assisted escape attempt.
Knocked to the floor by Gorilla while McQuaid slipped back in under the bottom rope.

matches.note: Down to the final two, Gorilla and Simon McQuaid, with Gorilla applying a submission hold, two masked men in black with purple "X"s on their chests attacked both men and left them unconscious outside the ring; the referee declared no winner. Vice President Smelly D had guaranteed the suspended Crazed Animals a spot in the match and a win for one of them; a court ruling shown earlier in the broadcast had already ordered them reinstated over President Hopper's objection.

date.source: The show's own title card and dateline, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy in five parts plus a dark-matches post.

appearances.note: Renamed TORA Wanizame after a supercard appearance in Japan; awarded the match by forfeit.
Fired on-air by President Hopper for missing his scheduled match, his contract torn up in the ring.
Managed Night Patrol to their loss.
Accompanied Shane Larson to his loss.
Managed Joe Williams to his Dangerzone title challenge.
Ran in to chase off the Crazed Animals after their post-match beatdown of Ryu Yamamoto, then was ambushed by Rune with a chair.

matches.note: Extreme's on-air debut; two masked men in black interfered mid-match, but the referee was distracted and did not see it. Burden won by pinfall after the lights briefly went out a second time.
Larson won with a bridging belly-to-back suplex.

Sengir failed to appear; President Hopper tore up his contract on-air, terminated him from the promotion, and awarded the match to Kabuki Master, now renamed TORA Wanizame after a supercard appearance in Japan.
The Mongolian Assassins won with their finisher, "the Twilight Drop," a top-rope elbow drop combined with a powerbomb.

matches.stipulation: NaWF/AeWF Dangerzone Championship, contested vacant after the 21 September battle royal ended without a winner.
matches.note: McQuaid became the first Dangerzone Champion, hitting the Psychotic Doctor's own interfering chair shot back at Gorilla and finishing with his own finisher, the Thunderstryker, after the Doc's run-in backfired.

matches.stipulation: No-holds-barred, no time limit, no disqualification, falls-count-anywhere main event; the pair's rubber match after two prior draws.
matches.note: A brawl through the arena's restroom, concession stand and broadcast booth ended when Durango's dive from the lighting scaffolding drove both men through the announce table; Durango covered for the pin.
Dark match; won in 48 seconds with a finisher he calls "the Spellbound," then powerbombed Valasquez from the ring to the floor after the bell, sending him to the hospital with a concussion.
Dark match against an unnamed local wrestler ("the Super Senator"); Rune won by pinfall with his finisher, "the Runestone."
Dark match against an unnamed local wrestler ("the Presidential Pimp"); Wardancer won by pinfall with his finisher, a suplex turned into a DDT he calls "the Eternal Peace."

Dark match; Yamamoto won by disqualification after Gorilla interfered at ringside. Afterward Gorilla powerbombed Yamamoto three times until Burden ran in to make the save, chasing the Crazed Animals off; Rune then ambushed Burden with a chair from behind the curtain.

date.source: The show's own title card and dateline, posted to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy in five parts plus a dark-matches post the following day.

appearances.note: Menaced Shane Larson's wife Robin at ringside, then beat Larson down with a chair after the bell while Robin looked on, seemingly hypnotized.
Menaced by Bobby Durango at ringside during her husband's match.
Guest on a taped "Jungle" interview segment with Smelly D, threatening President Hopper and the rest of the roster.
Guest on Gorilla's "Jungle" interview segment, accusing President Hopper of favoritism and mismanagement.
Wrestling as TORA Wanizame.
Handed Lt. Blazer a billy club, whose stray shot on Gorilla decided the main event.

matches.note: Larson's first loss in the promotion; Bobby Durango menaced Robin at ringside mid-match, distracting Larson, and Spellbinder finished with a Razor's Edge-style powerbomb. Durango beat Larson down with a chair after the bell while Robin, seemingly hypnotized, did not intervene.
Kabuki Master, now wrestling as TORA Wanizame, won with a handful of tights during a shooting-star senton splash cover.

The fight began backstage and spilled into the arena before the bell rang. Burden won by disqualification after Gorilla, who had been cheering Rune on, was jumped by Rune once Gorilla broke up a Burden pinfall. Afterward, the debuting Smith Twins (John Smith and Jim Smith) ran in, hit Burden with their finisher, and offered Rune a spot in a new stable, an offer left unresolved.

McQuaid retained after reversing a top-rope move into the Thunderstryker (a diamond cutter) for the pin, following interference attempts from both Gorilla (verbally) and Steve Jackson (tripping McQuaid, then being punched out by him).

matches.stipulation: Four-way elimination match for the vacant NaWF/AeWF North American Tag Team Championship.

eliminations.note: Pinned with a top-rope splash he calls "the Tetnis Shot."
Pinned after a double-team beatdown in the Mongolian Assassins' corner.
Pinned together with the Psychotic Doctor after the lights went out and two masked men in purple "X"s knocked both men (and Gorilla) down; Kublai covered both for the count.
Pinned together with Scott Powers in the same masked-interference spot.
Submitted to Gorilla's own finisher, a pumphandle into the Gorilla's Press.
Pinned after Lt. Blazer's billy club swing, meant for Genghis, struck Gorilla instead; the referee disqualified Blazer for the weapon shot on the same fall.

matches.note: The Mongolian Assassins became the first North American Tag Team Champions. Lt. Blazer was disqualified for the weapon shot that decided the match, but Genghis's simultaneous pinfall on Gorilla stood as the deciding fall.
Dark match, the English Avenger's debut; won with an inverted powerbomb.
Dark match; Wardancer was given the match by disqualification after Monty, on the edge of losing, used a chair.
Dark match, Knick Man's debut; won with a top-rope flying piledriver he calls "the Slam Dunk."
